about: Bands of fit for the tech role set, written by node evals/calibrate.mjs --roles tech (do not edit by hand). A score at or above 'strong' reads like people in the role; at or above 'in_range' it is in range for the role; at or above the 'related' line of the role's group it is a related background; below that, a different field so far. A group under 'no_bands' gets no band: show no verdict for its roles. web/match.js reads this with Matcher.bandOf(score, bands, group). The cut points hold only for scores made with createMatcher({ ..., distinct: scoring.distinct, behaviours: scoring.behaviours }) (behaviours 'show': a behaviour is a row with weight 0, credited through its carriers for display only). The tech matcher also takes distinct.baseline: the mean share of each skill over the MBA and tech roles (web/atlas.js, evals/lib.mjs techBaseline).

no_bands.legal: half of its same-role resumes score below its own bottom line
